*Dashboard 2: Pickup and drop-off volumes, imbalances, and average fares across NYC boroughs and hours of the day.*

### Significance

This dashboard investigates how pickup and drop-off patterns reveal potential supply-demand imbalances across NYC boroughs.

The flow visualization shows how taxi trips move between pickup and drop-off boroughs, while the hourly pickup and drop-off comparison highlights periods when substantially more passengers are entering or leaving a borough.

Large differences between pickup and drop-off volumes can indicate uneven taxi activity and provide a proxy for potential differences in service availability. The dashboard also compares average fares during these periods to investigate how fare patterns are associated with pickup and drop-off imbalances.

The Bronx is particularly useful to investigate because the exploratory analysis identified substantially more drop-offs than pickups in the borough.

### How to Use the Dashboard

Select a **pickup borough in the flow chart** to focus the remaining visualizations on trips originating from that borough.

Examine the hourly pickup and drop-off volumes to identify periods when the two values differ substantially.

Use the **brush interaction on the pickup/drop-off chart** to select particular hours of the day.

The difference visualization will update to show the magnitude and direction of the pickup/drop-off imbalance during the selected hours.

The fare visualization will also update, allowing you to compare average pickup and drop-off fares during those periods.

Try selecting different boroughs and hours to determine where the largest imbalances occur and whether those periods are also associated with differences in average fares.
